intro_en: Legal Agent Benchmark is Harvey's evolving benchmark for legal agents. The current official repository contains 1,660 closed-universe tasks and about 101,000 lawyer-authored atomic criteria across 24 legal practice areas plus contracting; each task runs in an isolated container and receives credit only when every criterion passes.
scale_en: 1,660 tasks / about 101,000 criteria / 24 practice areas plus contracting
metric_en: All-criteria task pass rate, pooled criterion pass rate
drawio_review_note: No associated research paper was found. Aligned with Harvey's May 6, 2026 official announcement and harveyai/harvey-labs repository snapshot f46ef86. Practicing lawyers turn realistic client matters into about 50-word partner-to-associate requests with closed-universe source documents and reviewable deliverables. Synthetic key and peripheral documents are generated in batches under lawyer guidance and review. Experts author atomic, binary, equal-weight, deliverable-scoped criteria rather than one golden output. The current evolving repository reports 1,660 tasks and about 101,000 criteria across 24 practice areas plus contracting; this supersedes the announcement's initial 1,250-task and 75,000-criterion counts. Each task runs in a network-disabled, capability-free Podman container with read-only sources, a writable output directory, and six file/shell tools. The default judge is Claude Sonnet 4.6 at temperature 0, judging one criterion semantically against only relevant deliverables. A task scores 1 only if every criterion passes; pooled criterion pass rate and operational diagnostics are secondary.
